title: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of…
description: IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway versions 1.0.0 through 1.0.11 contain a vulnerability where improper slug normalization can cause tool name collisions. This flaw allows a remote authenticated attacker to trigger a denial of service condition. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability.
